note: Owner comparison inputs for tools/progression2_wave2_candidates.py. Each option is a candidate Wave 2 set, NOT an adopted production recipe set. recipeEvidenceIds are Phase-1 matrix evidenceIds; every one must be class A-D (validated).

options.title: Lean data-only (A+B, zero new mechanic)
options.thesis: Ship immediately on the W1 pipeline: 9 recipes, 8 new ingredients, first white (fromage-blanc) base, first seafood-in-oil and pesto-protein variants, two no-CUT pizzas. Adds count and flavour, few new ways to play.

options.title: Sauce palette (B only, new PAINT sauces)
options.thesis: Keep the gesture, change what you paint: 6 new sauce colours (fromage-blanc white, miso, doubanjiang, curry-ketchup, tahini, yuzu-kosho) through the existing PAINT pipeline. Visible variety at the SAUCE step, but each sauce is a new ingredient + colour + Shop row.

options.title: No-sauce introduction (SAUCELESS_SCORING)
options.thesis: First pizzas with no SAUCE step: dough -> cheese -> toppings. Two need zero new ingredients (Aussie, Chilean Napolitana). Requires the sauce-less Scoring 2.0 / Reference / sauce-profile contract before any recipe ships.

options.title: Drizzle / multi-spread introduction (MULTI_SPREAD_LAYER)
options.thesis: Two spreads in order: paint the base, then drizzle oil or honey on top. Grandma and Sfincione need zero new ingredients; burrata and honey add a strong visual finish. Resolves the olive-oil -> DRIZZLE TODO in recipeSauceProfiles.ts.

options.title: Experience sampler (one pizza per new way to play)
options.thesis: Maximum variety per recipe: white base, no sauce, drizzle, post-bake topping, cheese-first order. Needs three to four mechanics at once (SAUCELESS_SCORING, MULTI_SPREAD_LAYER, FINISH, STEP_ORDER) -- highest cost and Human-Verification load.
